lines.text: You speak English like a textbook. Natives don't.
lines.tr: Parli inglese come un libro di scuola. I madrelingua no.

lines.text: You say: can you repeat, please? They say: sorry?
lines.tr: Tu dici: can you repeat, please? Loro: sorry?

lines.text: You say: I have understood. They say: got it.
lines.tr: Tu: I have understood. Loro: got it.

lines.text: You say: I'm fine, thank you, and you? They say: not bad, you?
lines.tr: Tu: I'm fine, thank you, and you? Loro: not bad, you?

lines.text: You say: goodbye. They say: see you!
Which ones do you still use? Tell me in the comments.
lines.tr: Quali usi ancora? Dimmelo nei commenti.

rows.book: I'm fine, thank you, and you?
